name: Tomorrow's Dawn

outcomes.criticalSuccess: The creature is unaffected and immune to this spell's effects for the remainder of the spell's duration.
outcomes.success: The creature is sickened 1 until the end of its turn.
outcomes.failure: The creature is sickened 1. In addition, it becomes slowed 1 until the end of its next turn.
outcomes.criticalFailure: As failure, but sickened 2 and the creature remains slowed 1 for the rest of the spell's duration.

entries: The golden light of a new dawn and the promise of life beyond death radiates from your body. You cast bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet) and gain mental resistance 5. Any nindoru fiend or undead that begins its turn adjacent to you must attempt a Will save with the following results.
